body: Drop one or several PDFs onto the window to merge them in the order you choose, or open one to select, rotate, delete, or reorder individual pages before saving a copy. Reading a scanned PDF's text is called out honestly: a scan is a page of images, not text, so there's nothing to extract.
screenshotAlt: Umbra's PDF tool showing large page previews of a two-page document with Read Text and Merge actions.

faqs.q: Why not merge or edit a PDF with a free online tool?
faqs.a: A PDF is often exactly the kind of document — a contract, an ID scan — you don't want passing through a third-party server.

faqs.q: Can it read text from a scanned PDF?
faqs.a: Not directly — a scanned page is an image, not text; the Image to Text tool's OCR can pull text out of the scan itself.

faqs.q: Is there a free tool to merge, rotate, or delete PDF pages without uploading them anywhere?
faqs.a: Umbra's is one of the few that does — none of DevUtils, DevToys, or CyberChef ship any PDF tool at all, and DevTools-X's is a viewer only. Umbra merges, reorders, rotates, deletes, and extracts pages, and never touches the file on disk until you explicitly save a copy.
